I loved the size, making it easy for my son to apply the paste to the brush with one hand. We both liked the fact that it allowed me to download a free Disney Magic Timer app on my phone. This app help count down time and kept his mind active, a bonus fact that made him want to brush his teeth again. I will be buying the same paste once this is emptied.

I believe he has actually wanted to brush his teeth more in the past month than he ever has in the past! That makes it a must have for this Mom!

My 11 year old son received this as a promotional product from Crest through BuzzAgent. I usually buy fluoride free toothpaste, but decided to allow my son to us this fun, Star Wars paste.  He really likes the taste and is excited - even after three weeks with the product- to brush his teeth.  My son usually complains about the toothpastes I buy, but this one was a hit.  Would recommend it if you aren't opposed to using fluoride.

reviews.t: I have a secrete love for creating toothpaste
reviews.x: I have a secrete love for creating toothpaste, but my kid is hard to convince unless it taste like bubble gum or some other crazy flavor. I was thrilled to get a free sample from Crest for my kid to try out. The toothpaste is awesome, performs really well but the kicker is the fact that it is Star Wars toothpaste that has to be Jedi approved as my kid puts it. The best toothpaste ever for kids in love with Star Wars!

The packaging is fun looking and easy for him to use AND CLOSE THE CAP :)  He loves the taste of the toothpaste and is excited about brushing his teeth.  He isn't interested in sharing with his big brother!  After one week of use his teeth look cleaner and stay looking cleaner longer!  Can a toothpaste do that?

reviews.x: For my son who is on the Autism Spectrum the Mint flavor was too strong, he really did not care for it and ended up not really using the product. Had it been a fruity flavor he might have used it more often but other then that our experience with Crest is a positive one. Wouldn't have probably purchase this particular toothpaste due to the price, but Crest sent this product free for my son to Try and I can say that he didn't complain about it being too "spicy". He enjoys the taste and looks forward to brushing his teeth with his "special toothpaste". He feels the toothpaste was made just for kids and not grown ups :-)

It said "kids" in the product description, and it was cheap; so I ordered it. The first time my 3-year old tried it she hated it. The 2nd time she tried it she hated it. It doesn't say "kids" anywhere on the packaging, except where it says "PRO HEALTH JR". Anyway, maybe Crest should have tried testing the flavor with kids.

reviews.t: Easy to use, but doean't like the minty flavor.
reviews.x: I received this free from Crest. The tube is easy to open and use and my son doesn't make a mess when he uses it. He doesn't like the taste very much, but he is not used to using minty flavored toothpaste, he usually uses a fruity flavored toothpaste. He likes how his breath smells after using this one, so he is going to try using it for a while.

reviews.t: Does the job - great mild taste for the kids!
reviews.x: We received a free tube from Crest to sample. I actually tested it myself before giving it to the kids, they're not too fond of the stronger "adult" toothpastes. A mild level of minty-ness - this was a good one for them. They liked the taste and they're really into Star Wars at the moment, so the graphic on the tube is a good bonus.

reviews.t: My son used this product and he loved the way it made his teeth feel so clean
reviews.x: We received the Crest Pro-Health Disney Star Wars toothpaste free from Oral B for the purpose of doing a product review. My son used this product and he loved the way it made his teeth feel so clean. He liked the the way it tasted. He gives two thumbs up to this product! The tube is easy to use and squeeze. Would recommend the toothpaste.

reviews.t: Same great product a good price
reviews.x: My son likes this toothpaste and I am happy to buy it as he is excited to use it to brush his teeth. As a prime customer it comes quickly at a price that is cheaper than your big box stores and you don't have to leave the house. A great product at a good price. We really like crest products and I dentist recommends them.

reviews.t: Great toothpaste, not a powerful minty feeling
reviews.x: I usually don't buy minty toothpaste because my kids complain about the feeling. I thought I'd take a chance on this one since we all love Star Wars. They tested it out & actually liked it! Our son, who is the biggest complainer, actually asked if I could buy it from now on. The tube fits in our toothpaste dispenser.

I received the Crest Pro-Health jr toothpaste to try for free thanks to Crest. The toothpaste was easy to squeeze out of the 4.2 oz tube. The Minty Breeze favor was just the right amount of mint to freshen your mouth without the burning feeling. My kids like it especially the picture of Star Wars characters on tube.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the minty flavor as pleasant and not too spicy, making it a good fit for kids moving on from fruity or bubblegum toothpastes.
The Star Wars theme and characters excite children and encourage them to brush without being nagged.
Many reviewers describe it as a good stepping stone between toddler toothpaste and adult toothpaste for older kids.
A few reviewers note the mint flavor was not their child's favorite or took some getting used to.
Several reviewers mention receiving the product free from Crest in exchange for an honest review.
